Application
APPLY NOW – until DECEMBER 1
Become part of the Max Planck Schools.
Apply by December 1 for a program start the following year!
Join the Max Planck Schools for an innovative graduate program in interdisciplinary research. Benefit from a unique network of leading scientists and funding for up to five years. Candidates with Bachelor’s or Master’s degrees are encouraged to apply!
APPLICATIONS NOW OPEN!
Embedded in a unique scientific network of currently 30 universities and 33 institutes from non-university research organizations the Max Planck Schools bring together Germany's leading scientists within a single doctoral program. As a PhD candidate of our joint graduate program you will have the opportunity to pursue topics at the forefront of fundamental and applied research.
APPLY HERE
WHY CHOOSE OUR PROGAM
Cutting-edge interdisciplinary research in the fields of Biomedical Artificial Intelligence, Cognition, Matter to Life, and Photonics
Close supervision by outstanding scientists from leading German universities and research organizations
Integrated MSc & PhD programs – or standalone PhD program
Early access to first-class research infrastructure and innovative teaching formats
Internationally competitive funding scheme – no tuition fees
FUNDING
Admission to a Max Planck School includes full funding for up to five years. This funding allows you to focus entirely on your scientific work. During the initial program phase (typically for those with a Bachelor’s degree), our PhD candidates receive an attractive scholarship and, if applicable, a subsidy for health insurance and material costs. Upon successful completion of the first phase, our candidates receive a contract in the second phase in accordance with the local Wage Agreement for Public Service (TVöD/TV-L, E 13), ensuring both academic freedom and financial security.
Further information on living costs, taxes and finances in Germany is available here.
WHO CAN APPLY
The Max Planck Schools invite highly ambitious and promising candidates from around the world to apply to their distinguished PhD programs. The Schools’ various PhD programs are open not only to Master’s graduates but also to talented Bachelor’s graduates seeking to establish a foundation for their scientific careers within the unique scientific network of the Max Planck Schools.
APPLY HERE
OUR APPLICATION PORTAL
To begin studying at a Max Planck School in the fall of a given year, applications must be submitted from September 1 to December 1 of the preceding year. Each School selects its candidates through a competitive multi-stage process. Applications must be submitted to the respective Max Planck School based on their specific requirements—see below for more information on these requirements.
Applications are accepted exclusively through our APPLICATION PORTAL.
Details regarding the recruitment process for each School can be found here:

If you aspire to be one of them, join the Max Planck Schools!
